findings.description: --max-drop is only honored inside the --compare branch, so passing --max-drop without --compare silently skips the regression check and exits 0.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a CI job runs `eval --max-drop 0.03` without `--compare`. The `if args.compare:` block is never entered, so regression() is never called and the command succeeds. Impact: the operator believes a regression gate is active when no check runs, so a hit@5 drop passes unnoticed.
